_about: SHELF of Sanskrit and Hindi classics in English before 1931, by translators with no shelf of their own: H. H. Wilson's Theatre of the Hindus (1835) and Megha Duta (1813), Palmer Boyd's Nagananda (1872), C. H. Tawney's Bhartrihari (1877), F. S. Growse's Ramayana of Tulsi Das (1883), and Arthur Avalon's (Sir John Woodroffe's) Tantra of the Great Liberation (1913) and Serpent Power (1924). Griffith, Edwin Arnold, Monier-Williams, Ryder, Max Müller's Sacred Books of the East and the Harvard Oriental Series are on their own shelves. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 83); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Bare 'wilson' is left out as a common surname other shelves claim.
